# Context menus on linux; enablement per state: disconnected, connected, running, busy
editor.context, for the query editor
  &Insert Snippet…  Ctrl+K Ctrl+X  +++-
  &Surround With…  Ctrl+K Ctrl+S  +++-
  ---
  C&onnection >
    &Connect…  ++++
    &Disconnect  -+--
    Disconnect &All Queries  -++-
    &Reconnect…  ++++
    ---
    C&hange Connection…  ++--
    &Environment…  -++-
  ---
  E&xecute  F5  ++--
  Ca&ncel Executing Query  Alt+Pause  --+-
  &Display Estimated Execution Plan  Ctrl+L  -+--
  Display &Estimated Plan in Query Session  -+--
  ---
  Cu&t  Ctrl+X  ++++
  &Copy  Ctrl+C  ++++
  &Paste  Ctrl+V  ++++
  ---
  Comm&and Palette…  Ctrl+Shift+P  ++++
documentTab.context, for a saved query's tab
  &Save  Ctrl+S  +++-

  ---
  &Close  Ctrl+W  +++-
  Close All &But This  +++-
  C&lose All  +++-

  ---

  &Open Containing Folder  ++++
  ---
  Mov&e Left  Ctrl+Shift+PageUp  ++++
  Move &Right  Ctrl+Shift+PageDown  ----
  Re&name Tab…  F2  ++++
  ---
  Increase Tab Stack &Height  ----
  Decrease &Tab Stack Height  ----
  ---
  Spl&it Right  Ctrl+\  ----
  Split Do&wn  Ctrl+K Ctrl+\  ----
  Move to Ne&xt Group  Ctrl+Alt+Right  ----
  Mo&ve to Previous Group  Ctrl+Alt+Left  ----
  &Float  ----

explorer.context, for a database
  New &Query  -++-
  Searc&h Objects…  -+++
  Pee&k  Alt+F12  ----
  ---
  &Script Database as >
    &CREATE To >
      &New Query Editor Window  -++-
      &File…  -++-
      C&lipboard  -+++
    &ALTER To >
      &New Query Editor Window  -++-
      &File…  -++-
      C&lipboard  -+++
    &DROP To >
      &New Query Editor Window  -++-
      &File…  -++-
      C&lipboard  -+++
    DROP A&nd CREATE To >
      &New Query Editor Window  -++-
      &File…  -++-
      C&lipboard  -+++
  ---
  &Tasks >
    &Detach…  -+++
    ---
    &Take Offline  -+++
    Bring &Online  -+++
    ---
    &Restore >
      &Database…  -+++
      &Files and Filegroups…  -+++
  ---
  Copy N&ame  -+++
  ---
  Rena&me  F2  -+++
  D&elete  Delete  -+++
  ---
  Re&fresh  F5  -+++
  ---
  &Properties  -+++

explorer.context, for a table
  Select Top 1000 Ro&ws  -++-
  Pee&k  Alt+F12  ----
  ---
  &Script Table as >
    &CREATE To >
      &New Query Editor Window  -++-
      &File…  -++-
      C&lipboard  -+++
    &ALTER To >
      &New Query Editor Window  ----
      &File…  ----
      C&lipboard  ----
    C&REATE OR ALTER To >
      &New Query Editor Window  ----
      &File…  ----
      C&lipboard  ----
    &DROP To >
      &New Query Editor Window  -++-
      &File…  -++-
      C&lipboard  -+++
    DROP A&nd CREATE To >
      &New Query Editor Window  -++-
      &File…  -++-
      C&lipboard  -+++
    ---
    &SELECT To >
      &New Query Editor Window  -++-
      &File…  -++-
      C&lipboard  -+++
    &INSERT To >
      &New Query Editor Window  -++-
      &File…  -++-
      C&lipboard  -+++
    &UPDATE To >
      &New Query Editor Window  -++-
      &File…  -++-
      C&lipboard  -+++
    D&ELETE To >
      &New Query Editor Window  -++-
      &File…  -++-
      C&lipboard  -+++
    ---
    E&XECUTE To >
      &New Query Editor Window  ----
      &File…  ----
      C&lipboard  ----
  ---
  Copy N&ame  -+++
  ---
  Rena&me  F2  -+++
  D&elete  Delete  -+++
  ---
  Re&fresh  F5  -+++
